title: New Insights into How Melatonin Ameliorates Bisphenol A-Induced Colon Damage: Inhibition of NADPH Oxidase.
authors: Yao, Yujie; Zhu, Wenjing; Han, Dongxu; Shi, Xu; Xu, Shiwen
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褪黑素缓解BPA诱导的结肠DNA损伤，涉及NOX和DNA修复通路，但核心是氧化应激与细胞周期，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，仅分子对接为边缘方法。
abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA) is an endocrine disruptor, widely employed, and detected in many consumer products and food items. Oral intake poses a great threat to intestinal health. Melatonin (MT) stands out as an endogenous, dietary, and therapeutic molecule with potent antioxidant capacity. To explore the protective effect of MT against BPA-induced colon damage and the role of NADPH oxidase (NOX) in this process, we established mice and colonic epithelial cell (NCM460) models of BPA exposure and treated with MT. In vitro and in vivo results showed that MT ameliorated BPA-induced oxidative stress, DNA damage, and the G2/M cell cycle arrest. MT also downregulated the expression of NOX family-related genes, reversed the inhibition of the base excision repair (BER) pathway, promoted the activation of non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ) pathway, and suppressed the mRNA and protein expression of ATM, Chk1/2, and p53. Diphenyleneiodonium chloride (DPI), a NOX-specific inhibitor, also attenuated the toxic effects of BPA on NCM460 cells. Furthermore, molecular docking revealed that MT could bind to NOX. Conclusively, our finding suggested that MT can ameliorate BPA-induced colonic DNA damage by scavenging NOX-derived ROS, which further attenuates G2/M cell cycle arrest dependent on the ATM-Chk1/2-p53 axis.
abstract_zh: 双酚A（BPA）是一种内分泌干扰物，广泛使用，并在许多消费品和食品中检测到。口服摄入对肠道健康构成重大威胁。褪黑素（MT）作为一种内源性、膳食性和治疗性分子，具有强大的抗氧化能力。为探讨MT对BPA诱导的结肠损伤的保护作用及NADPH氧化酶（NOX）在此过程中的角色，我们建立了BPA暴露的小鼠和结肠上皮细胞（NCM460）模型，并用MT处理。体外和体内结果表明，MT改善了BPA诱导的氧化应激、DNA损伤和G2/M细胞周期阻滞。MT还下调了NOX家族相关基因的表达，逆转了碱基切除修复（BER）通路的抑制，促进了非同源末端连接（NHEJ）通路的激活，并抑制了ATM、Chk1/2和p53的mRNA及蛋白表达。NOX特异性抑制剂二苯基碘鎓氯化物（DPI）也减弱了BPA对NCM460细胞的毒性效应。此外，分子对接显示MT能与NOX结合。总之，我们的发现表明，MT通过清除NOX来源的活性氧（ROS）来改善BPA诱导的结肠DNA损伤，进而减弱依赖于ATM-Chk1/2-p53轴的G2/M细胞周期阻滞。
